independence_statement: Independent image-only second reading. I had not read scan028 before this assignment. Read access was limited to CONVENTIONS.md, the assigned scan028 box-coordinate TSV, the original scan028 JPG and crops generated directly from it. No witnesses, edition text, first-reader output/crops/notes, comparison records, OCR, external research or compilation were used. Kind labels were treated only as locator categories; live/deleted states were inferred from the ink.
crop_method: Fresh crops from source JPG; Pillow autocontrast; resized to 3000 px across using LANCZOS; UnsharpMask radius 1, percent 60, threshold 3. Main crops unrotated; one additional narrow arrow detail rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise.

records.observations: Curved upper loop and diagonal descending baseline identify 2; rising diagonal, descending right shaft and horizontal crossbar identify a crossed 7. No cancellation.

Several long oblique strokes cross the entire upper passage from lower left to upper right; they are cancellation, not underlining. The heading has its own underline and short crossing strokes. Original serifed I/J symbols are blackened and K appears beside/over them; relation/figure names use an open G/C shape. The two displayed formulas retain raised circles, coproduct and explicit index pair. In prose, les classes has looped l and compressed asses; rel. and d'équiv. show terminal dots. borne has tall b and low orne; sup has deep p descender. The interlinear d'équiv sits above an overwritten H/R. la famille has its own horizontal deletion. Final deleted A_k/B_k precedes C_k. Further enlarged top and middle details inspected at 19:34:12 UTC.

Tall P, joined ro, descending p, and dotted i/t cluster support Proposition. Separate baseline underline survives; several short oblique strokes cut the heading, in addition to cancellation of the whole upper paragraph.
Small loop then shallow n/s humps and terminal dot read ens.; looped d with long low e stroke reads de. Large looped L followed by a dot. The excerpt belongs to the diagonally cancelled top passage.

The first word begins a large open C and has three low o/n/s forms, struck by horizontal and oblique strokes; no secure final dot. The second has tall looped S, low o, dot over i, and tall t with rightward exit: Soit. Enclosing paragraph is cancelled.

Two tall shafts survive, with a hooked diagonal rising toward the upper right and two sweeping transverse cancellation strokes. K is the tentative underlying letter, H remains possible; entire top block is also cancelled.

K stands left of a blackened serifed I/J with top and bottom horizontals. Round A,B parentheses, membership, multiplication cross, open C-like G with a lower right hook, and vertical set separator are present. Raised rings are attached to A and B; crossed equals and slashed oval give nonempty condition. Long diagonals cross the entire formula.

First word has initial joined small loop, tall looped l, then a; final word has q bowl and long descender followed by low u/e. Middle word has a broad low entry, two shallow humps and tall terminal t; tentatively veut, with diagonal cancellation across it.

Left pair of figure bars runs into the intersection arch; the second figure is open C-like with lower hook. Large coproduct has two uprights and continuous lower bar. Index contains (A,B), membership and a blackened serifed I/J with K written over/right of it. Raised circular marks follow A and B. Long diagonal strike crosses the left side.
Initial r/e, tall looped l, tall t with nearby i dot and long low ons ending remain under one continuous horizontal cancellation. Entire paragraph also has long diagonal cancellation.
Looped d and apostrophe precede small accented e, q with deep descender, u, dotted i and open final v, followed by a separate dot. A long diagonal crosses d/e.

Small raised interlinear text has d, apostrophe/acute cluster, q with descender, low u and separate dotted i followed by v. No secure terminal period appears. Placement above an overwritten letter before the next line identifies an insertion; enclosing block is cancelled.

Left capital is blackened by several horizontal/diagonal overwrites; two uprights support H, but R cannot be excluded. Hyphen is separate. Following cursive has short initial stems, a tall d-like shaft, low u, i dot, tall t and low e ending; the last s is not secure. Long paragraph strike passes through the ending.

Left p descends below the baseline, followed by a compressed ar stroke. Two large looped R letters with lower F and open G/C subscripts; connecting et has low e and tall pointed t. A dot follows final subscript; thin diagonal cancellation crosses the second R.

Initial tall loop and small a form la; next tall f has both upper and lower loops, followed by low a/m/i and two tall l shafts with final e/s-like hook. The whole phrase is traversed by a distinct horizontal strike, inside the cancelled paragraph.

Small initial d/e/s cluster is darkened by a short near-horizontal cancellation; tentative des. Following p descender and low our are unambiguously separate. k has tall stem and right arms, followed by two equals strokes and (A,B). Two thin diagonal block strikes cross this line.

At left an overwritten A-like triangular form with small lower k is heavily cancelled; B remains possible because of upper loop. Separate small dot lies before clear open C with lower k. Equals, A, intersection arch and B are clear. Thin diagonal crosses the formula as part of the paragraph cancellation.

L is at apex. Separate open curved subset signs lie along the two rising diagonals, without arrow shafts. S is clear at left; right node has a large S-like curve with prime, an additional top bar/slash, and a small T-like form below/right, so correction to T is tentative. Two vertical shafts end in downward arrowheads at serifed I and I'; labels have phi loops and cursive surj, with prime on right. Detail at 19:34:25 UTC shows a horizontal bar and diagonal cutting the old S, with the smaller T-like replacement below-right; prime remains separately visible.
Serifed I, comma and hooked J precede low cursive ens with period. Final word has round o, shoulder r and tall looped d with separate period. No strike.

records.observations: Upper diamond has S at top, S-intersection-T at left, L at right, T below. Four curved inclusion arrows have hook-like starts and terminal arrowheads toward S, L, T and L. Phi's vertical path shows an upward-pointing thick head near S and a separate downward head above I; whether the upper strokes are cancelled is unclear, so bidirectional/single-down alternatives are preserved. Psi shaft from S-intersection-T ends near the overwritten K without a distinct arrowhead. Lower K has directed arrows up-right toward I and right toward I'. T to I' has a downward arrowhead and phi-prime label. Bottom K is written over an earlier serifed hooked J/I. Rotated detail inspected at 19:34:36 UTC confirms the upper arrow-like point and multiple thick parallel strokes.

Broad top bar, long curved bottom turning far left and original right shaft suggest J. Added left upright, rising diagonal and lower right leg give K superposed on it. Original I remains possible because top and bottom are both serif-like; overwrite is local, without a paragraph cancellation.
Four compressed low forms precede clear angular K: an open a-like entry, broad v trough, small e rise and c/n-like ending; tentative avec. There is no crossing stroke through the word or K.

K equals Im is followed by an opening parenthesis, S-intersection-T, a rightward arrow carrying (phi,phi'), and I times hooked J, then closing parenthesis. The set after equals uses I times I' explicitly. Tuple second member has a deep j-like hook and raised prime; i' remains possible. Second A is written over a B-like double loop; subscript and prime survive on its right. Nonempty sign and closing brace appear at the page edge.

Opening brace, tuple, membership and product are distinct. Second tuple character descends and hooks left with a separate raised diagonal prime; uncertain j'/i'. In the second intersection term, an angular A lies over two earlier rounded B lobes. A prime and raised ring plus lower i' survive. Only this symbol is overwritten; no strike cancels the entire set expression.

Looped cursive S with separate i dot reads Si. The free j has a descending shaft and broad left foot; tuple contains two dotted i forms, the second primed. After comma there are low on strokes, then a looped a and shallow ura ending.

Text agrees with the left excerpt. Box is drawn with all four sides, right side doubled/thickened; formula contains A with long descending j, equals, A with dotted lower i, intersection arch, and primed A with lower i followed by prime. No cancellation.

Left cursive has small e/t, low on, then descending p with low ose. Upper formula has triangular A, a conspicuous raised short vertical to its right and a small lower i-like mark, so A'_i/A_i is retained as uncertain. Phi has minus-one above; parentheses enclose I with lower less-than/equal and i. Lower left has B lobes overlain by A diagonals, prime and long j. Lower phi is primed with minus-one; I' and lower less-than/equal-j are visible.
